# A — declares a recognized edge to itself

Lifecycle: active
Role: milestone
Project: reciprocal-self-edge
Updated: 2026-05-20

Related:
- precedes: a.md
- depends-on: ./a.md

## Body

A self-referential recognized edge is EXEMPT from `missing-inverse`
(applicability condition 5). There is no second document whose context
could be completed, and `docs relate` refuses a self-edge outright — so a
finding here would name a repair the repair verb declines to perform. The
second bullet spells the same self-edge non-canonically, pinning that the
exemption survives path normalization.
